#QuakeCydn

QuakeCydn is a fork of QuakeSpasm, a modern version of the Quake engine. Not much has changed yet, except that I am busy porting parts of the engine to C++.

1.AI use
I used AI to help port some parts to C++. Every place where I used it is marked with a comment in the code and listed below.

I don't hate AI. But just as some people don't like making pictures with AI because they see drawing as art, I see code as art. I believe hand-written code is the most beautiful, not because it is perfect, but because you can see and feel the programmer in it.

4.AI used index
CydnMath.h: BoxOnPlaneSide: ported from C with help from (tool name), because I find C macros hard.
README.txt: Help with English grammar, spelling and wording (English is not my first language).

5. About the AI disclosure
I'm open about where I used AI because I think that's honest, not because I owe anyone an explanation. This is a hobby and I do it for fun. If you'd rather not use code that was AI-assisted, the index above tells you exactly where it is. Feedback on the code is always welcome.
